scripts.build:pages: rm -rf dist && cp -r public dist && cp src/worker.js dist/_worker.js
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build:pages && cd pages && wrangler d1 migrations apply wsel --local --persist-to .wrangler/state && wrangler pages dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && cd pages && wrangler pages deploy --project-name patricksly --branch main --commit-dirty=true
